title: Chapter 1364 - 30: Temporal Lifeform ’Galaxy’ (End Of Volume)
content:
Chapter 1364 - 30: Temporal Lifeform ’Galaxy’ (End Of Volume)

Chapter 1364: Chapter 30: Temporal Lifeform ’Galaxy’ (End of Volume)

There’s no way around it; even the birth of ordinary time life is quite conspicuous, not to mention Lin Yuan at this moment.

"Why do I feel the Chaos Qi has thinned by half overall?"

"A great time life has been born."

"Yes, I feel the cause and effect of the Galaxy Great Saint, the Galaxy Great Saint has crossed into the 13th tier."

...

All the Great Saints of the Chaos Realm seemed to be stirred up.

Compared to Luo Hou’s recent crossing into the 13th tier, the impact of the Galaxy Great Saint crossing into the 13th tier was far greater.

Luo Hou, although possessing the power of an Invincible Great Saint, is merely an ordinary Invincible Great Saint. But the Galaxy Great Saint? The strongest Invincible Great Saint throughout history, the only one to emerge since the Chaos Void originated.

"An era of prosperity, I didn’t expect two great time lives to be born in succession."

"Indeed, witnessing the birth of two time lives in person is not a wasted life."

"I’ve decided, I’m going to attempt to reach the 13th tier now."

The thoughts of the many Great Saints of the Chaos Realm are complex. Throughout the long Cosmic Era, being able to witness the birth of one 13th tier is already considered an extremely rare fortune.

Moreover, two? Two in a row?

"Did you notice, when the Galaxy Great Saint crossed into the 13th tier, the phenomenon was much stronger than that of Luo Hou Great Saint."

The numerous Great Saints of the Chaos Realm, far from possessing the insight methods of time life, could not perceive the changes in the Chaos Void.

But they clearly felt the difference in the richness of the Chaos Qi.

When Luo Hou Great Saint crossed into the 13th tier, the concentration of Chaos Qi throughout the Chaos Void hardly changed.

But Lin Yuan crossing into the 13th tier directly led to a 50% drop in Chaos Qi concentration?

This kind of difference led many Great Saints of the Chaos Realm to faintly realize that even among great time lives, there are disparities.

All the Great Saints of the Chaos Realm did not know that the difference they perceived was just the tip of the iceberg, a mere drop in the ocean.

Just a 50% decrease in Chaos Qi concentration? If the Chaos Void wasn’t doing its utmost to maintain it within a certain range, it wouldn’t just be a 50% decrease but a complete drain.

...

"Galaxy has crossed into the 13th tier?"

On the Galaxy Chaos Continent, Xia Qin Supreme and other nine Supremes were excited, and the 12th tier evolvers born after leaving their home universe were even more thrilled.

The stronger the power, the higher the realm, the more one can realize what a 13th tier time life truly entails.

The difference between 12th tier and 13th tier, although only one tier apart, is the gap between time life and non-time life.

For a time life, lives below the 13th tier are as simple as thin paper, seeing through past, present, and future at a glance.

The Great Saints of the Chaos Void, all pursue traces of time life, longing for a slight hint from time life.

"Galaxy..."

Though Xuanyuan Supreme was excited and jubilant, he couldn’t help but feel endless amazement in his heart.

Since he noticed Lin Yuan in his home universe, Lin Yuan’s growth has never ceased, now even effortlessly breaking through the 12th tier to the bottleneck of the 13th tier, not even monsters can describe.

...

Three hundred and thirty-three breaths later.

The infusion of the Chaos Void Origin gradually ceased.

Whether breaking through from the 11th tier to the 12th tier or from the 12th to the 13th tier, the infusion time of the Chaos Void Origin is three hundred and thirty-three breaths.

In these three hundred and thirty-three breaths, how much Chaos Void Origin one can endure entirely depends on oneself.

"Is it over?"

Lin Yuan’s expression showed a hint of lingering expectation.

Even with the full infusion of Chaos Void Origin, it still only made him about 70% full.

The reason for this is that Lin Yuan intentionally held back.

If he truly indulged in devouring and absorbing Chaos Void Origin.

Until he was completely full and even overstuffed.

He could certainly achieve it.

But it might cause irreversible impacts on the Chaos Void.

Definitely, it would completely drain the Chaos Void, leaving its origin empty and depleted.

Even if the Chaos Void didn’t immediately suffer a great destruction, the eventual great destruction time would be pushed forward.

This goes against Lin Yuan’s wishes. Though he indeed wants to use the Chaos Void Origin to enhance his power.

But he doesn’t want to bring any significant impact on the Chaos Void, after all, it also counts as his hometown.

Now this 70% full is just right.

As for the rest, it can be made up through the inexhaustible dark energy permeating the dimensional gaps.

Though the absorption efficiency is not as good as directly devouring Chaos Void Origin, with the blessing of the Lord’s status.

The devouring of dark energy in the dimensional gaps won’t be much inferior to that of a real Time Lord.

After crossing into the 13th tier, more uses for the Lord’s status were unearthed, aside from enhancing the ability to observe future timelines.

The absorption and devouring of dark energy also underwent significant enhancement.

...

"My current power..."

Lin Yuan started to examine himself. Now he has initially entered the 13th tier, strictly speaking, not even fully crossing into the First Realm.

Even so, due to the depth of his foundation, Lin Yuan’s frontal battle prowess surpasses most Second Layer time lives.

As for the capability to observe timelines, with the Lord’s status blessing, it also reaches nearly the level of a Time Lord.

"The Lord’s status... its help is really significant for me."

Lin Yuan marveled in his heart, at the level of time life, mere battle means alone cannot be dominant.

Without corresponding abilities to observe timelines, even if one surpasses the opponent’s battle prowess, one would still be led by the nose.

The enemy can’t beat you?
